label: C3 分栏核对
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied desktop UI reference into a polished same-style composition option for the Chinese trade app 贸易协同. Same landscape aspect, target1600x1000. Keep the selected visual world exactly: charcoal#171C20, cyan#00A8B5, magenta#B63E85, lime#C9E766, system Chinese sans and flat rectangular panels, TOP horizontal navigation, no left app sidebar. Keep trade business subject and functional UI, not a poster. No gradients/glass/neon halos/photos. Header tradebrand, nav 工作台/订单查询/单证管理/审核与异常/统计分析, search, ZJG zhoujg, readonly业务主管,退出登录. Title订单工作区 with small原型样例 badge.
All exact source rows must appear once in the table: SO2026001,24,100.00 USD,执行中,待审核,部分收款; SO2026003,19,500.00 EUR,待执行,未开始,未收款; SO2026005,28,150.00 USD,执行中,制作中,未收款. Columns订单/金额/订单进度/单证进度/收款进度/操作. Right-align all amounts. Selected SO2026001 amount24,100.00USD, paid12,000.00USD, unpaid12,100.00USD. Never sum different currencies. Actions查看订单/审核单证 only, no直接新建订单, no收款登记 forboss. Never invent dates, extra facts, statuses, records or permissions. No role dropdown.
Correct errors from reference: ALL text on cyan and lime color fields is charcoal#171C20 (not white); white text allowed on magenta. 部分收款 and待审核 tags are AMBER with dark text, never green. 执行中 is cyan or neutral, notsuccessgreen. Keep订单/单证/收款 THREE independent statuses clearly labeled, no sequential combined journey. All controls real-looking and readable, 13-15px-equivalent body, title28-32px.
COMPOSITION C3, list-and-inspector: keep topbar~66px and title; below title split workspace LEFT66% order list and RIGHT34% persistent selectedorder inspector. Left contains compact filters and the three-row continuous table with all independentstatecolumns and rightalignedamounts; no big coloredtiles above list. Right inspector starts selected SO2026001 heading and has THREE STACKED flat colored sections of visibly different heights: cyan orderprogress/24,100.00USD; magenta docprogress/待审核; lime paymentprogress/部分收款 with12,000.00USD已收and12,100.00USD未收. Each has its own heading and state, allread-onlyexceptbottom查看订单/审核单证 buttons. Coloredsections fill RIGHT region only, lefttable stayscharcoal calm. Right bottom actions pinnedwithinpanel; no verticaltimechains. Lettable andselectedcontext stayvisible together, strongcleanarchitecturalcolumns, neitherposter norfamiliarwhitecards.
